∀ (input : NJP_PermutationPacket.State)
  (states : Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 23) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 23))) → NJP_PermutationPacket.State)
  (control : Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 22) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 22))) → Prod.{0, 0} Nat NJA_Trace.Kind)
  (cut : NJP_ControllerTrace.Cut input states control),
  And
    (@Eq.{1} NJP_PermutationPacket.State
      (states (Fin.last (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 22) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 22)))))
      (NJP_PermutationPacket.model input))
    (And
      (@Eq.{1} (Aeneas.Std.Result.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Unit NJP_PermutationPacket.State))
        (@Aeneas.Std.Result.ok.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Unit NJP_PermutationPacket.State)
          (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} Unit NJP_PermutationPacket.State Unit.unit
            (states (Fin.last (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 22) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 22)))))))
        (@Aeneas.Std.Result.ok.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Unit NJP_PermutationPacket.State)
          (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} Unit NJP_PermutationPacket.State Unit.unit (NJP_PermutationPacket.model input))))
      (∀ (r : Fin (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 22) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 22)))),
        @Eq.{1} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat NJA_Trace.Kind)
          (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} Nat NJA_Trace.Kind
            (@NJA_Trace.Event.round NJE_RoundTrace.State (NJE_RoundTrace.observed input states r))
            (@NJA_Trace.Event.kind NJE_RoundTrace.State (NJE_RoundTrace.observed input states r)))
          (control r)))
